newsitem.title: UK: Budgens says trading matches expectations.
newsitem.headline: Budgens says trading matches expectations.

text.p: British supermarket group Budgens Plc said on Thursday its progress so far this year remained in line with current market expectations, although conditions were "highly competitive" and price inflation remained at a low level.

The group, which operates town centre supermarkets and petrol station mini-stores, also announced a 1.5 million stg advertising campaign and a price promotion. The "three mile price promise" offers customers refunds of double the difference if they can buy an equivalent product at a lower price within a three mile radius of their local store.
The range of products covered by the promotion will change every two weeks. The campaign, timed to coincided with the group's 125the anniversary, will run throughout the year.
In January, Budgens announced first-half, pre-tax profits of 5.04 million stg, on sales of 183.0 million.
